title: Observability & Production
intro: Production observability for Rails means more than log files. This page covers the three pillars — logs, metrics, traces — in the Rails context: Lograge replaces Rails' noisy multi-line request log with a single structured JSON line that includes controller, action, duration, and status; Semantic Logger adds correlation IDs and structured fields. rack-mini-profiler shows SQL queries and rendering time in development; Skylight, Scout, and Datadog APM provide distributed tracing in production. rbspy samples a running Ruby process without restart — the depth marker for production profiling. Sentry captures exceptions with stack traces, release tracking, and sampling. The SLO/SLI section covers the four golden signals and how to define error budgets for a Rails API. The incident response section covers the blameless post-mortem format.
